title: WW Internal Tooling
summary: Account management and internal tools at WW International, from a portal for UK members who join through a free government program to agent-driven tooling that keeps WW's apps up to date and right-sized.
responsibilities: Built Claude Code agents and custom CLIs that migrated about 20 apps to Argo CD and right-sized them from New Relic usage data, opening the pull requests themselves and saving about $60K a year.
Built Claude Code skills that verify pull requests by writing and running Playwright scripts.
Set up the Next.js (App Router) app for the UK program with TypeScript and the Ant Design component library.
Managed a team of three engineers. Acted as a point of contact and divided tasks.
Led weekly client demos of new key functionality.
features: Agent-operated CLIs that open pull requests across dozens of repos
Automated pull request checks with Playwright
CSV report generation for government audits
OKTA login and role-based access control using NextAuth
User data tables with filtering and pagination
